narrative.summary: A self-administered TimelockController with a real, confirmed 24-hour delay controls both governance and proxy upgrades on one shared storage slot. Its proposer is an Avocado multisig (6 of 12 signers) and its executor a 3-of-5 Safe, the same committee as Fluid on Arbitrum One.
narrative.tag: 67 to 59, cross-exposure 100 to 80 (pushed on-chain 2026-09-20, Plasma testnet block 34100595)
narrative.detail: owner() reverts by design (a custom "infinite proxy", not Ownable): the real admin getter is getAdmin(), independently re-derived via keccak256 rather than copied from docs. The proposer answers requiredSigners() = 6 and signers() = 12 (an Avocado multisig, not a Safe: the first pass tried only the Safe interface), the executor is a Safe v1.4.1, 3-of-5, and both read identically on Arbitrum One. Four of the five executor owners are also among the twelve signers. Four active Liquidity auths (config-handler contracts whose TEAM_MULTISIG() is the same multisig) and the guardian act without the delay, so timelockScore is capped at 55. The oracle was rewritten with these values on 2026-09-20 (the earlier 40 / 100 / 70, composite 67, is superseded).
